1	'use client'
2	import { format } from 'date-fns'
3	import { CalendarIcon } from 'lucide-react'
4	import * as React from 'react'
5	
6	import { Calendar } from '@/components/ui/Calendar/Calendar'
7	import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton, InputGroupInput } from '@/components/ui/InputGroup/InputGroup'
8	import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from '@/components/ui/Popover/Popover'
9	import { parseDate } from './date-utils'
10	
11	export type DateInputProps = {
12	  value?: Date | null
13	  /**
14	   * Called whenever the user commits a value (on blur, Enter, or calendar selection).
15	   *
16	   * `null` is passed for **all** non-valid states — the caller cannot distinguish
17	   * between them from this callback alone:
18	   *
19	   * - **Cleared:** the input is empty or whitespace only.
20	   * - **Unparseable:** the text could not be parsed as a date.
21	   * - **Out-of-range:** the parsed date falls outside `minDate`/`maxDate`.
22	   *
23	   * Consumers that need to distinguish these cases should inspect `data-invalid` on
24	   * the underlying `<input>` element, or track the raw text value independently.
25	   */
26	  onChange?: (date: Date | null) => void
27	  minDate?: Date
28	  maxDate?: Date
29	  disabled?: boolean
30	  placeholder?: string
31	  className?: string
32	}
33	
34	export function DateInput({
35	  value,
36	  onChange,
37	  minDate,
38	  maxDate,
39	  disabled,
40	  placeholder = 'mm/dd/yyyy',
41	  className,
42	}: DateInputProps) {
43	  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false)
44	  const [inputText, setInputText] = React.useState<string>(value ? format(value, 'MM/dd/yyyy') : '')
45	  const [isInvalid, setIsInvalid] = React.useState(false)
46	  const [month, setMonth] = React.useState<Date | undefined>(value ?? undefined)
47	  const isFocusedRef = React.useRef(false)
48	
49	  // Sync external value changes into the input display, but skip while user is typing.
50	  // Always clears stale invalid state when the effect runs — including when value is null.
51	  React.useEffect(() => {
52	    if (isFocusedRef.current) return
53	    setInputText(value ? format(value, 'MM/dd/yyyy') : '')
54	    setIsInvalid(false)
55	  }, [value])
56	
57	  // Pre-compute day-boundary-normalized min/max dates once per prop change
58	  // instead of allocating new Date objects for every day the Calendar renders
59	  // (30-40+ invocations per render when both bounds are set).
60	  const normalizedMinDate = React.useMemo(
61	    () => (minDate ? new Date(minDate.getFullYear(), minDate.getMonth(), minDate.getDate()) : null),
62	    [minDate],
63	  )
64	
65	  const normalizedMaxDate = React.useMemo(
66	    () => (maxDate ? new Date(maxDate.getFullYear(), maxDate.getMonth(), maxDate.getDate()) : null),
67	    [maxDate],
68	  )
69	
70	  function isInRange(date: Date): boolean {
71	    const dateStart = new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate())
72	    if (normalizedMinDate && dateStart < normalizedMinDate) return false
73	    if (normalizedMaxDate && dateStart > normalizedMaxDate) return false
74	    return true
75	  }
76	
77	  function commit(text: string) {
78	    if (!text.trim()) {
79	      setIsInvalid(false)
80	      onChange?.(null)
81	      return
82	    }
83	
84	    const parsed = parseDate(text)
85	
86	    if (!parsed) {
87	      setIsInvalid(true)
88	      onChange?.(null)
89	      return
90	    }
91	
92	    if (!isInRange(parsed)) {
93	      setIsInvalid(true)
94	      onChange?.(null)
95	      return
96	    }
97	
98	    setIsInvalid(false)
99	    setMonth(parsed)
100	    onChange?.(parsed)
101	  }
102	
103	  function handleInputChange(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
104	    setInputText(event.target.value)
105	  }
106	
107	  function handleFocus() {
108	    isFocusedRef.current = true
109	  }
110	
111	  function handleBlur() {
112	    isFocusedRef.current = false
113	    commit(inputText)
114	  }
115	
116	  function handleKeyDown(event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
117	    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
118	      commit(inputText)
119	    }
120	    if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
121	      event.preventDefault()
122	      setOpen(true)
123	    }
124	  }
125	
126	  function handleCalendarSelect(date: Date | undefined) {
127	    if (!date) return
128	    const formatted = format(date, 'MM/dd/yyyy')
129	    setInputText(formatted)
130	    setIsInvalid(false)
131	    onChange?.(date)
132	    setOpen(false)
133	  }
134	
135	  // Stable callback referencing memoized boundary dates — avoids allocating
136	  // new Date objects for every day the Calendar renders (30-40+ per render).
137	  // Normalize the incoming date to local midnight so that any time-of-day value
138	  // DayPicker passes does not cause a boundary day to be incorrectly disabled,
139	  // consistent with the normalization isInRange applies.
140	  const isCalendarDateDisabled = React.useCallback(
141	    (date: Date) => {
142	      const dateStart = new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate())
143	      return (
144	        Boolean(normalizedMinDate && dateStart < normalizedMinDate) ||
145	        Boolean(normalizedMaxDate && dateStart > normalizedMaxDate)
146	      )
147	    },
148	    [normalizedMinDate, normalizedMaxDate],
149	  )
150	
151	  return (
152	    <InputGroup className={className}>
153	      <InputGroupInput
154	        type="text"
155	        value={inputText}
156	        onChange={handleInputChange}
157	        onFocus={handleFocus}
158	        onBlur={handleBlur}
159	        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
160	        placeholder={placeholder}
161	        disabled={disabled}
162	        data-invalid={isInvalid || undefined}
163	        aria-invalid={isInvalid || undefined}
164	      />
165	      <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
166	        <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
167	          <PopoverTrigger render={<InputGroupButton size="icon-xs" aria-label="Open calendar" disabled={disabled} />}>
168	            <CalendarIcon />
169	          </PopoverTrigger>
170	          <PopoverContent className="w-auto p-0" align="end">
171	            <Calendar
172	              mode="single"
173	              selected={value ?? undefined}
174	              month={month}
175	              onMonthChange={setMonth}
176	              onSelect={handleCalendarSelect}
177	              disabled={isCalendarDateDisabled}
178	            />
179	          </PopoverContent>
180	        </Popover>
181	      </InputGroupAddon>
182	    </InputGroup>
183	  )
184	}
